title: Learning types
memoryHook: Labels teach, clusters discover, rewards steer.
facts: Unsupervised learning discovers patterns in unlabeled data.
Reinforcement learning learns actions from rewards and penalties.
confusions: Classification predicts categories; regression predicts numeric values.

title: Embeddings
facts: Embeddings represent semantic information as numeric vectors.
Semantically similar content tends to have nearby vectors.
confusions: Tokenization splits input; embedding maps content into vector space.

title: RAG versus fine-tuning
memoryHook: RAG supplies facts; fine-tuning shapes behavior.
facts: Retrieval augmented generation adds relevant external context at inference time.
Fine-tuning changes model behavior by training on task-specific examples.
confusions: Use RAG for changing private knowledge; do not fine-tune merely to inject frequently changing facts.

title: Responsible AI
facts: Responsible AI includes fairness, explainability, privacy, safety, controllability, veracity, and governance.
confusions: Transparency communicates how a system is built and used; explainability helps people understand model behavior.

title: Security service compass
memoryHook: IAM grants, KMS encrypts, CloudTrail records.
facts: AWS IAM controls identities and permissions.
AWS CloudTrail records API activity for auditing.
confusions: Amazon Macie discovers sensitive data in Amazon S3; it is not an identity service.
